pending_interview.question: A mid-sized logistics company approaches you. They want to add AI-powered document processing to their operations — specifically, automatically extracting key fields from freight invoices and customs declarations (which currently requires a team of 12 people doing manual data entry). They have no internal ML team, a two-year-old ERP system (enterprise resource planning — the core business operations software), and a hard requirement that the solution be live within six months. Walk me through how you would scope this engagement, what you'd need to know before recommending an approach, and how you'd think through whether to build a custom model, use an off-the-shelf AI document processing service, or some combination of both.
